conditions.condition: Compressor starts running, but does not load after a delay time

rows.fault: Inlet valve stuck in closed position
Minimum pressure valve leaking (when net is depressurized)

conditions.condition: Compressor does not unload, safety valve blows
Condensate is not discharged from condensate separator during loading
Compressor air output or pressure below normal

rows.fault: Air consumption exceeds air delivery of compressor
Inlet valve does not fully open

conditions.condition: Excessive oil consumption; oil carry-over through discharge line

rows.remedy: Check for overfilling. Release pressure and drain oil to correct level.
Replace non-return valve in the scavenge line

conditions.condition: Compressor element outlet temperature or delivery air temperature above normal

rows.fault: On air-cooled compressors, insufficient cooling air or cooling air temperature too high
rows.remedy: Check for cooling air restriction or improve ventilation of the compressor room. Avoid recirculation of cooling air. If installed, check capacity of compressor room fan
Check and correct; if necessary, clean the aftercooler of the compressor
Check and correct; if necessary, draw cooling air via a duct from a cooler place or relocate the compressor
Have circuit checked for leaks and recharged

conditions.condition: Condenser pressure too high or too low

rows.fault: Fan control switch out of order
Fan blades or fan motor out of order

rows.remedy: Check and correct; if necessary, draw cooling air via a duct from a cooler place or relocate the compressor

conditions.condition: Compressor stops or does not start

rows.fault: Electric power supply to compressor is interrupted
Thermal protection of refrigerant compressor motor has tripped
rows.remedy: Motor will restart when motor windings have cooled down
Have system inspected. Clean the filter of the automatic drain by opening the manual drain valve. Check functioning of the drain by pushing the test button.

conditions.condition: Condensate trap continuously discharges air and water

rows.remedy: Have system checked. If necessary, replace the automatic drain.

conditions.condition: Evaporator pressure is too high or too low at unload

rows.fault: Hot gas bypass valve incorrectly set or out of order
rows.remedy: Have hot gas bypass valve adjusted

rows.fault: Condenser pressure too high or too low

rows.remedy: Have circuit checked for leaks and recharged if necessary
